Fixed the discussion deep-link right now (`3564002` on `main`, `a3d6d0f` here, live on the server), and here is why both happened:

## 1. Why ntfy didn't open discussions automatically (fixed now)
- The board UI already supported `#/post/_orchestrator?disc=<id>`, but three links in the chain were missing:
  1. `notify.py` only built `#/post/<post_id>` and never appended `?disc=<discussion_id>`.
  2. Replies sent via `board_cli.py reply` only carried `reply_to: "thr_..."`, not the parent's `discussion` id—`board_server.py` now resolves `discussion` from the parent thread before pushing to ntfy.
  3. The unlock page redirected with `location.replace('/')`, which **wiped `location.hash`** (`#/post/...?disc=...`) right after auto-unlocking. It now redirects to `'/' + (location.hash || '')`.
- Tapping **this** notification should open this exact discussion directly.

## 2. Why it felt like every ntfy link had a different token
- **ntfy links never contain a token** (`https://penguin.tail53fb79.ts.net/#/post/...`, kept out of URLs so `ntfy.sh` never sees your secret), and every checkout on `penguin` now shares the exact same machine token (`~/.config/board-kit/board_token`).
- **Why your phone still showed the Unlock screen:** tapping a link inside the ntfy app opens `https://penguin.tail53fb79.ts.net` in a separate browser context (in-app browser / Chrome Custom Tab) that does **not** share cookies or `localStorage` with an installed PWA or a Tailscale IP origin (`http://100.x.x.x:8765`). And before today's unified machine token, browsers holding an older checkout's token (older than the 1 entry in `retired_tokens`) also got `401`.
- **To stop seeing Unlock from ntfy:** unlock once in the browser that ntfy opens (or set ntfy to open links in your default browser where `penguin.tail53fb79.ts.net` is already unlocked)—with the hash-preservation fix above, auto-unlock will now also keep your `?disc=...` target.
